milestone: P8 Deterministic Hook / Policy Engine Final Evidence
capabilities: Extended hooks.json schema supporting typed event/tool/path filters (HookPolicyRule) and argv action
Explicit failure policies: warn, block, ignore with configurable default fallback
Preserved 100% backward compatibility for legacy hooks (preTool, postTool, stop, user_prompt_submit)
Content identity binding (SHA-256) and resolved path verification in trust store
Fails closed on disk modification or revoked trust without restarting process
Native and model tools prohibited from granting trust or injecting executable hooks
Supervised process execution with bounded JSON stdin/stdout/stderr (64 KiB)
Process tree termination on timeout or cancellation (taskkill /F /T /PID on Windows, process group on Unix)
Host-owned recursion prevention with depth counter (max_depth: 3)
Observer events record unmet completion requirements without claiming retroactive file reversal
Aggregate diagnostics via /hook-status command with trust, rule, and unmet requirement reporting

package_tests.command: rtk proxy cargo test --offline --locked -p davinci-coding-agent --test hook_policy

lint_checks.fmt: rtk proxy cargo fmt -p davinci-agent -p davinci-coding-agent --check (exit 0)
lint_checks.clippy: rtk proxy cargo clippy --offline --locked -p davinci-agent -p davinci-coding-agent --all-targets -- -D warnings (exit 0)
